faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Answer the questions teams usually ask first.
faq.description: If you care about source, permissions, and operational fit, these are usually the points that decide whether a system can enter real business use.

aside.label: Why these questions matter
aside.title: The real friction is rarely just model quality.
aside.body: Teams usually care more about whether an answer can be handed off with citations, whether boundaries stay constrained, and whether source onboarding feels practical. Those are the production questions.

sources.question: Do citations and source versions stay attached to the answer?
sources.answer: Yes. Groundpath is designed so the answer, citations, freshness, and source entry points appear together instead of being reconstructed at export or handoff time.

security.question: Can permissions and knowledge scope be locked before generation?
security.answer: Yes. Organization boundary, knowledge base scope, and allowed material narrow first, and the model only works inside that controlled context.

setup.question: Is it heavy to start with the source material we already have?
setup.answer: No. You can begin with one document set or one knowledge base, validate traceability and review flow, and then expand to broader team material over time.

handoff.question: Can the team continue operating on the answer after it is generated?
handoff.answer: That is the point. Groundpath does not just hand over a polished paragraph. It hands off an answer object with citations, scope, and review signals still attached.
